reference_observations.description: Centered subject occupies primary vertical axis with upper text zone and lower mechanical object zone
Purple/violet key light illuminates subject from below-center, creating dramatic facial modeling and rim separation
Acid-green fill and accents from upper text region
Layered depth with foreground cables, midground subject, background machinery, and atmospheric haze
Dominant violet-purple palette with acid-green chromatic accent and deep neutral shadows
Central mechanical infinity-shaped object with electrical energy and cables
Overscale acid-green graffiti text 'SEM PROMPTS' in upper third
Subject with raised hands, palms facing inward toward central object
Mixed materials: metal machinery, rubber cables, fabric blazer, glass/energy
Purple electrical lightning and glow emanating from central object

decisions.target: Subject remains centered in square thumbnail; upper zone reserved for calm negative space or clean technical graphics, lower zone features target-native technical focal element
decisions.rationale: Centered dominance creates ceremonial stability and immediate hierarchy essential for personal brand recognition in a square thumbnail format

decisions.target: Purple/violet key light from below or screen source models subject face and glasses; green accent used sparingly on technical elements or rim
decisions.rationale: Purple lighting communicates technical authority and invention; must be balanced with fill to preserve facial recognizability and glasses clarity

decisions.target: Layered technical environment using server racks, code screens, circuit patterns, or data visualization planes instead of mechanical machinery
decisions.rationale: Layered depth creates immersion and technical context; must be native to technology personal brand rather than generic industrial aesthetic

decisions.target: Maintain violet-purple dominant value structure with controlled chromatic accent; accent may be green or target-owned technical hue
decisions.rationale: Violet-purple creates technical energy and premium darkness; accent provides vitality and focal contrast

decisions.target: Replace literal infinity mechanical assembly with target-native technical focal point: holographic interface, code stream, circuit diagram, or abstract data visualization with motivated glow
decisions.rationale: The function is a central technical focal point demonstrating mastery; the literal infinity symbol and mechanical assembly are source-specific and prohibited by brief

decisions.target: No text overlay per brief constraints; typography function replaced by subject and technical environment hierarchy
decisions.rationale: Source text 'SEM PROMPTS' is prohibited; graffiti style conflicts with technical authority tone; brief specifies text_overlay_expected false

decisions.target: Subject pose adapts to interacting with target-native technical elements (gesturing toward screen, touching device, or open hands showing engagement) while keeping face and glasses front-facing and recognizable
decisions.rationale: Active hand position communicates engagement and control; exact reference hand pose and mechanical object interaction are not required

decisions.target: Material contrast between subject wardrobe (fabric) and technical environment (metal, glass, screen) preserved; specific industrial materials replaced with clean tech materials
decisions.rationale: Material contrast enriches hierarchy and tactile interest; must remain native to technology domain

what_must_survive: Subject face and facial geometry from Image A
Centered subject dominance for thumbnail clarity
what_should_survive: Layered technical depth with foreground/midground/background separation
Energy and invention atmosphere through motivated glow
Dark neutral value structure with selective vitality
what_can_change: Specific environment objects (mechanical machinery to servers/code/circuits)
Hand pose and gesture (exact reference pose not required)
Exact accent color (green may shift to target-owned hue)
Camera distance and crop within square format
key_conflicts: Source text 'SEM PROMPTS' prohibited by user constraint
Literal infinity mechanical assembly prohibited by user constraint
Reference styling must not override target subject identity preservation
recommended_anchors: Centered authority composition with subject as clear hero
Purple key light with dark shadows and controlled fill on face
Layered technical environment with atmospheric depth
Central technical focal element demonstrating mastery
Acid-green or equivalent accent for chromatic energy
creative_opportunities: Replace mechanical infinity with holographic code stream or data visualization
Use actual computer screens or server arrays as light sources and depth planes
Incorporate subtle circuit board patterns or digital grid in background
Hands could interact with touchscreen, device, or gestural interface
Wardrobe could shift to tech-casual or creative professional while maintaining authority
warnings: Avoid generic cyberpunk clichés (random cables, neon without source, unmotivated particles)
Protect facial recognizability under purple lighting at thumbnail size
Do not add text overlay unless explicitly required by future brief revision
Ensure glasses remain readable and not lost in shadow or reflection
Maintain approachable confidence; avoid hostility or excessive darkness
